stories.title: Follow live: Derrick Henry makes history in Rio de Janeiro as Ravens hold lead
USC suspends LB Stephens after ejection for hit on Oregon QB Moore
stories.summary: USC is suspending linebacker Desman Stephens II one game for his conduct in Saturday night's 41-27 loss to Oregon following a late hit on quarterback Dante Moore.

stories.title: S. Carolina star Stewart suspended after punching Bama player
stories.summary: South Carolina star edge rusher Dylan Stewart has been suspended indefinitely after he threw a punch at an Alabama player during Saturday's loss.

stories.title: 'Walking mismatch' Stewart too much for favored Lynx in Game 1
stories.summary: Breanna Stewart put up 34 points and 12 rebounds to help the Liberty to a Game 1 upset of the No. 1-seeded Lynx.

stories.title: Fins on RB Achane's knee injury: 'Doesn't sound very optimistic'
stories.summary: Dolphins running back De'Von Achane suffered a knee injury against the Chiefs and was ruled out.
